name: codex-cost-orchestrator
description: Fast role-aware Codex orchestration with thin skills, static native Agent routing, and exact-state acceptance evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Static native Agent routes with exact-state acceptance.
interface.longDescription: Codex Cost Orchestrator is a thin local control plane for Codex native Agents. Primary supplies one schema-validated canonical DAG; CCO derives dependency-ready waves, strict direct-dependency owner reuse, static native routes, scoped workspace baselines, reader/writer admission, continuation cursors, restart fencing, and acceptance-ID evidence. Mechanical work prefers Luna only when the active V2 backend exposes it, otherwise Terra is selected directly; bounded and guarded work use Terra, and a guarded plan receives one final independent reviewer unless the current plan explicitly accepts risk. Codex remains the only Agent runtime, while Primary keeps intent, integration, and final acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Implement and verify this feature with CCO's default static route.
